why.label: Why start now
why.statement: Businesses that are transition ready sell more quickly and receive better offers. Owners who are unprepared, or who wait until the timeline is short, usually leave value on the table.

signals.title: You don't have a clear number
signals.text: You know roughly what the business earns, but not what a buyer would actually pay for it, or why.

signals.title: Too much still runs through you
signals.text: Customers, decisions and know-how depend on you. That makes the business harder to sell and harder to step away from.

signals.title: Nobody has been chosen to take over
signals.text: Family, management, a partner or an outside buyer? Without a decision, there is no plan to work towards.

paths.label: Who takes over?
paths.title: Every exit is different. *Start with yours.*
paths.intro: Choose the path that sounds closest to your situation and see where we come in.

items.title: Passing the business to your family
items.text: We help prepare your children to lead, protect your retirement through the handover, and keep family relationships strong while ownership and control change hands.

items.title: Transferring to people inside the company
items.text: Your managers and key employees already know the business. We help structure a transfer that works for them and for you, on a timeline that makes sense.
points: Readiness of the internal team assessed

items.title: Selling to a third party
items.text: Buyers pay for businesses that are predictable and ready. We help you get there before you go to market, so you negotiate from a stronger position.
points: Value gaps closed before the sale
Legal and tax experts involved early

items.title: Planning between shareholders
items.text: When there is more than one owner, everyone needs to know what happens next. We help shareholders align and put buy-sell agreements in place.
points: Clear plan for each owner's exit

items.title: Still weighing your options
items.text: That is a very common place to start. We help you define what you want personally and financially, then compare each path against those goals.
points: Personal, business and financial goals defined
A first roadmap, whatever you decide

process.label: How it works
process.title: From first conversation to a *finished transition.*

steps.title: A confidential conversation
steps.text: Call or email to set up a first meeting, wherever feels most comfortable and confidential for you. We explain our methodology and get a first read on how ready you and your company are.

steps.title: Assess value and readiness
steps.text: We look at where the business stands financially and structurally, what it is worth today, and what stands between you and the outcome you want.

steps.title: Build your roadmap
steps.text: Together we write a plan that takes you from where you are now to a transition that is legally, financially and personally straightforward.

steps.title: Execute, one goal at a time
steps.text: We stay with you as advisor, coach and manager, working with your legal and tax experts. Many clients partner with us for years, completing one goal and moving to the next.

items.q: When should I start planning my exit?
items.a: Earlier than most owners expect. For many, the process begins years before they want or need to sell, because that is how long it takes to make the changes that improve cash flow and value. The sooner you start, the more options you keep.

items.q: Do you replace my attorney or CPA?
items.a: No. We are fee-based business advisors. We frequently involve legal and tax experts to improve valuation and protect your proceeds at the sale, while our role in the process is advisor, coach and manager.

items.q: What happens in the first meeting?
items.a: We explain our methodology and assess how ready you and your company are for a transition. We are happy to meet wherever is most comfortable and confidential for you.

items.q: Can you help if I want to pass the business to my family?
items.a: Yes. Family business succession is at the core of what we do, from preparing the next generation to lead, to protecting your retirement through the handover.
It depends on where you are today and what you want. Many clients work with us for several years, completing one goal and then moving on to the next.
